why_it_fails: resolution/website discovery: fallback search returned NO_LEAD. Stored evidence shows html.duckduckgo.com answers HTTP 202 with a bot challenge and www.bing.com/search answers 200 with unrelated Microsoft pages for the quoted-address query, so no candidate website is ever found even though the brand site exists. Cresco detection (adapters.py:141) is hard-coded to the host cloud9dispensaries.shop, so a Cresco white-label on any other domain is classed 'unsupported'.
fix_idea: Replace the fallback search with a working source (e.g. the OpenRouter web plugin the verifier already uses, or a brand-level locator) and treat a results page where nothing names the store as a search failure, not 'no lead'. Detect Cresco by api.crescolabs.com calls / whitelabel_tag instead of one hostname, and add a Cresco provider (key mechanism: docs/JANE_SOURCE_RESEARCH.md ~line 156).
